implementation_summary: auditShareRoutes({ store, optOutText }) returns the rows for listShares (view), createShare (owner), revokeShare (owner) and sharedPage (public, beta allow), all taken from AUDIT_API, plus a GET '/s' prefix row (public, beta allow) that gives malformed ids the same 404 body. Create checks the body (kind, optional language and version), returns 404 ERR_AUDIT_NOT_FOUND for an unknown audit or version and 409 ERR_AUDIT_RUNNING for a running version. It makes the snapshot first: a pitch link renders the Pitch Glimpse through G5's generatePitchGlimpse (Page Content, edits, screenshots as data: URIs, opt-out text); a preview link copies the stored preview.html, and a missing preview answers 409 with the fixed NO_PREVIEW_MESSAGE. It then calls store.createShare and writes the snapshot to shareSnapshotKey under the audit lock; if that write fails the link is revoked and the reply is 500. Revoke calls store.revokeShare and returns { link }. /s/:linkId uses resolveShare only for status and the link record, never its AuditSummary (F-009), and serves the stored snapshot with a robots meta tag added. Every /s/ reply carries X-Robots-Tag noindex nofollow, Referrer-Policy no-referrer, Cache-Control no-store, nosniff, X-Frame-Options DENY and the CSP default-src 'none'; img-src data:; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none', and clears any Set-Cookie prepared before it. Unknown and malformed ids get one identical 404 page; revoked, expired and deleted-audit links get a small 410 page with data-code=ERR_LINK_GONE.

risks: Error code: no stored preview (and no finished result) answers 409 with code ERR_INVALID_REQUEST, which AUDIT_ERROR_CODES documents as a 400. A dedicated code would need a packages/types change (not owned).

CSP differs from ADR 0036 text: follows the acceptance criterion (img-src data:; style-src 'unsafe-inline') instead of the ADR's img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self', because the Pitch Glimpse uses inline <style>. The ADR may need updating.
Extra row: a GET '/s' prefix row (public, beta allow) is not an AUDIT_API entry; BE-190's registration test must accept it.

Beta copy: server.ts dispatch runs enterSession/sessionFor before the handler, which prepares a cookie; the handler removes it, but the beta rate limit and betaScope still apply to /s/ (server.ts and beta.ts not owned).
Stored preview.html is served as written. The CSP blocks script, forms, framing and external resources, but not <meta http-equiv=refresh>; BE-605's cleaning step must remove it.
resolveShare still loads the full AuditSummary internally (store code, not owned); the route never uses it or puts it in a reply.
handoff: BE-190: register auditShareRoutes({ store, optOutText }) from packages/runner/src/routes/audit-share.ts in allRoutes in packages/runner/src/routes/index.ts (this is the shared registration line). optOutText is a required async function returning the saved Partial<Record<DocumentLanguage,string>> from the audit settings. There are five rows, including the GET '/s' prefix row for malformed ids. /s/ is public and matched before the access-key gate. FE-601: create returns 201 { link }; list returns { links } including revoked and expired links; revoke returns 200 { link }; refusals use AuditErrorReply (409 ERR_INVALID_REQUEST with NO_PREVIEW_MESSAGE, 409 ERR_AUDIT_RUNNING, 404 ERR_AUDIT_NOT_FOUND for an unknown audit, version or link). Snapshots live at audits/<id>/shares/<linkId>/snapshot.html, so deleting the audit removes them.
